councilAgentModule.title: Council of Diverse Lenses
councilAgentModule.tagline: AI-powered council deliberation system for diverse perspectives and auditable decisions
councilAgentModule.description: Multi-persona deliberation with safety gates and auditable briefs. Creates diverse perspectives to debate complex topics and surface agreements, disagreements, and unknowns.
councilAgentModule.featureMultiPersonaDesc: Debate topics from diverse perspectives including Security, Ethics, Finance, and Policy lenses
councilAgentModule.featureSafetyDesc: Built-in harm detection and content filtering to ensure responsible AI usage
councilAgentModule.featureAuditableDesc: Complete audit trail with attestation hashes for transparency and compliance
councilAgentModule.featureIntegrationDesc: Publish directly to Slack and Confluence with customizable templates
councilAgentModule.mcpBody: The Council Agent supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) for seamless integration with external AI systems and tools.
councilAgentModule.roomSubtitle: Debate topics from diverse perspectives and generate consensus briefs
councilAgentModule.challengeBody: Add more diverse personas to challenge your assumptions and get different perspectives on complex topics.
councilAgentModule.mapSubtitle: Visualize agreements, disagreements, and unknowns across deliberations
councilAgentModule.runsSubtitle: Monitor deliberation executions and audit trails
councilAgentModule.runsEmptyHint: Run a deliberation to see results here
councilAgentModule.settingsSubtitle: Configure personas, safety thresholds, and publishing options
councilAgentModule.harmHint: Content with harm risk above this threshold will be blocked
councilAgentModule.minPersonasHint: Minimum number of personas required for deliberation
councilAgentModule.maxPersonasHint: Maximum number of personas allowed per deliberation
councilAgentModule.autoPublishHint: Automatically publish briefs to configured channels when deliberation completes
councilAgentModule.slackChannelHint: Default channel for publishing Council Briefs
